title: Policy Gradient Theorem
learning_objective: Explain and derive the policy gradient theorem and implement a baseline actor-critic.

definitions.definition: A tuple (S, A, P, r, gamma).

theorems.name: Policy Gradient Theorem
proof_steps: Write J as expectation over trajectories.
Use log-derivative trick: \nabla p = p \nabla \log p.
Rearrange to get the final expectation.

implementation_targets: Implement Actor-Critic and run on CartPole
verification_checklist: Check the theorem derivation in a textbook or original paper
Verify sign conventions and discount handling
Confirm baseline does not introduce bias

references.citation: Sutton & Barto (2018), Reinforcement Learning: An Introduction
Williams (1992), Simple statistical gradient-following algorithms for connectionist reinforcement learning
